components.name: Site Glass Navigation
components.description: Compact navigation shared by every route and protected against bright media.
components.css: .ds-home-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;height:64px;padding:0 16px;background:rgba(18,29,50,.36);color:rgba(255,255,255,.96);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgba(4,10,22,.22)}.ds-home-nav a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;font:700 16px Roboto,sans-serif;padding:12px 16px;border-radius:8px;text-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.85),0 0 12px rgba(0,0,0,.55);transition:background .2s}.ds-home-nav a:hover,.ds-home-nav a:focus-visible{background:rgba(255,255,255,.16);outline:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.8);outline-offset:2px}

narrative.overview: The home route is an immersive viewing surface for authored cherry-blossom media. Every route shares one glass navigation language, while reading content remains on opaque cards with the profile sidebar and compact metadata.
keyCharacteristics: Reading content aligned directly below navigation

rules.name: The Two-Surface Rule
rules.body: Navigation may use atmospheric glass on every route; reading-content surfaces remain opaque.

rules.name: The One-Sentence Rule
rules.body: The home glass panel contains one literary sentence and no feature or CTA stack.

rules.name: The Protected Transparency Rule
rules.body: Transparency may reveal media but never erase labels, placeholders, or icons.

rules.name: The Immediate Reading Rule
rules.body: Reading content starts 0.75rem below navigation and never uses viewport-height banner spacing.

dos: Do keep the animated background as the dominant home-page signal.
Do preserve the article cards, sidebar, metadata, and responsive order.
donts: Don't place article lists or profile panels on the home route.
Don't use atmospheric glass for reading-content containers.
